mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating increased consumer spending, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% for 3 consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 100,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between labor market signals and SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increasing by more than $10 billion in a month, signaling robust consumer demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns during strong consumption periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The difference between the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) inflation rate (CPIAUCSL YoY growth) narrowing below 1% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between monetary policy signals and SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the natural rate of unemployment (estimated around 5%) serves as a baseline; when actual unemployment (UNRATE) is below this rate, labor market tightness predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns during labor market tightness periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, combined with a positive change in housing starts (HOUST), signals robust demand and predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between demand signals and SPX returns remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
